## Glyphling 0.6.1

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.6.1.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place.

### Fixed
- **Tutorial scrollbars**: the full-screen tutorial no longer shows scrollbars.
- **Tutorial only on the first launch**: whether it was shown is now saved in the settings file, as soon as it opens, so it does not come back after closing the app halfway or after an update. Settings > Info > "Rivedi il tutorial" still shows it on demand.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
